  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Mines Surveyor",
  "description": "Mosra Energy Limited Nigeria (MEL) is a well-established coal mining company with over 15 years experience in the industry. We are operating coal mines in Kogi and Delta States. In addition to our current operations, we have several other coal blocks under exploration in Nsukka/Udenu, Enugu State, Dekina LGA, Kogi State, and Ogbadibo LGA, Benue State.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Mines Surveyor

Job Location: Obolloafor, Enugu
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Surveyor who will be responsible for:


	Provide input in specifying the ground support systems, processes and equipment for safe, economical, and environmentally sound extraction or underground construction activities.
	Implement, and coordinate mining plans and safety programs


Key Duties and Responsibilities


	Conduct initial surveys, risk assessments and environmental impact assessments on potential sites to assess whether plans are workable.
	Select locations and plan underground or surface mining operations, specifying processes, labour usage, and equipment that will result in safe, economical, and environmentally sound extraction of minerals and ores.
	Implement and monitor the development of mines, facilities, systems, or equipment.
	Inspect mining areas for unsafe structures, equipment, and working conditions.
	Examine maps, deposits, drilling locations, or mines to determine the location, size, accessibility, contents, value, and potential profitability of deposits.
	Select or develop mineral location, extraction, and production methods, based on factors such as safety, cost, and deposit characteristics.
	Prepare technical reports for use by mining, engineering, and management personnel.
	Monitor mine production rates to assess operational effectiveness.
	Prepare schedules, reports, and estimates of the costs involved in developing and operating mines.
	Predict the environmental effects and impacts of mining, including air pollution and destruction of the landscape and devise solutions such as methods of storing excavated soil and returning exhausted mine sites to natural states
	Evaluate data to develop new mining products, equipment, or processes.
	Design, develop, and implement computer applications for use in mining operations such as mine design, modeling, or mapping or for monitoring mine conditions.
	Perform any other duties assigned by the Head, Mining operations.
	Implement and coordinate mine safety programs, including the design and maintenance of protective and rescue equipment and safety devices.


Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s degree or its equivalent in Survey or related discipline.
	Minimum of five (5) years mining experience in operations, engineering and project evaluation


Skills and Competencies:


	Proven experience in Surface mine design and development.
	Good knowledge of the cement manufacturing industry.
	Working knowledge of mine equipment selection, capital cost and operating cost estimates.
	Working knowledge of surveying technology/ mine planning software such as Mine sight, AutoCAD or other mine development software.
	Ability to interpret maps, charts and graphical data
	Strong scientific and mathematical background
	Methodical approach to work practices with strong emphasis on quality.
	Ability to pay attention to details.
	Good analytical skills.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their CV and relevant credentials to: hr@mosraenerji.com using the Job Position as the subject of the application.",

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Mines Surveyor

Job Location: Obolloafor, Enugu
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Surveyor who will be responsible for:

	Prepare technical reports for use by mining, engineering, and management personnel.
	Monitor mine production rates to assess operational effectiveness.

	Evaluate data to develop new mining products, equipment, or processes.
	Design, develop, and implement computer applications for use in mining operations such as mine design, modeling, or mapping or for monitoring mine conditions.
	Perform any other duties assigned by the Head, Mining operations.
	Implement and coordinate mine safety programs, including the design and maintenance of protective and rescue equipment and safety devices.

	Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent in Survey or related discipline.
	Minimum of five (5) years mining experience in operations, engineering and project evaluation

	Proven experience in Surface mine design and development.
	Good knowledge of the cement manufacturing industry.
	Working knowledge of mine equipment selection, capital cost and operating cost estimates.
	Working knowledge of surveying technology/ mine planning software such as Mine sight, AutoCAD or other mine development software.

	BSc Degree in Marketing or a related field/Certification

	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Excellent Marketing and customer service skills.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Competitive

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Sales & Inventory Records Officer",
  "description": "G-Shoppers provide easy food shopping support to homes, career men, and women and business people who are faced with the challenge of being constantly away from home and have less or no time to shop as well as cook.

We execute orders to supply food stuff and items such as fresh meat, sea foods, frozen, dry foods, vegetables, fruits, and prepped ready to cook food ingredients. We are based in portharcourt.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales &amp; Inventory Records Officer

Job Location: Eliozu, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are looking for a smart, organised and detail-oriented Sales &amp; Inventory Records Officer to accurately record daily business transactions, maintain sales and inventory records, and ensure all transactions are properly documented and completed on time.
	The ideal candidate must have good knowledge of Google Sheets and Google Docs, be comfortable working with figures and demonstrate a high level of accuracy, organisation and accountability.


What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days


	All daily sales, procurement, inventory and related transactions are accurately entered and closed out on the same day.
	Invoices and proforma invoices are prepared accurately and promptly.
	Product information, prices and inventory records are consistently updated.
	Errors, missing entries and discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly.
	Supporting documents are properly maintained and easy to retrieve.
	Management can rely on the accuracy and completeness of daily business records.


What You Will Do


	Enter daily customer sales transactions accurately into the company&rsquo;s business management software.
	Prepare and generate invoices and proforma invoices as required.
	Record all procurement transactions, purchased inventory, stock movements, discounts and other relevant business transactions.
	Ensure all daily transactions are accurately entered, verified and closed out before the end of each working day.
	Maintain and update product listings, prices and other relevant information in the company&rsquo;s software.
	Identify price differences and communicate with the Procurement Team for confirmation and necessary updates.
	Review daily entries, identify missing records or discrepancies and follow up to ensure corrections are made.
	Maintain accurate sales, procurement and inventory records with proper supporting documentation.
	Coordinate with the Inventory Officer, Sales and Procurement Teams to ensure records are complete and consistent.
	Prepare simple records and reports when required by management.


Requirements


	OND, HND or Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree.
	Good working knowledge of Google Sheets and Google Docs.
	Ability to organise data, work with basic spreadsheet formulas and maintain accurate records.
	Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel is an advantage.
	Strong numerical ability and excellent attention to detail.
	Good organisational and time-management skills.
	Good written and verbal communication skills.
	Ability to work independently, follow instructions and meet deadlines.
	High level of honesty, integrity and accountability.
	Ability and willingness to learn new business management software. Previous experience with such software is not required.
	Relevant work experience is an advantage but not compulsory.
	Must currently reside in Port Harcourt, preferably in Eliozu or within reasonable commuting distance.


Salary
N100,000 per month (starting salary), with opportunities for salary review and growth based on performance and demonstrated competence.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: gshoppersrecruitment@gmail.com using &quot;Sales &amp; Inventory Records Officer &ndash; Location in Port Harcourt&quot; as the subject of the mail.

Application Question(s)
Answer these two questions in the body of your email:


	How would you rate your knowledge of Google Sheets and Google Docs (Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced)?
	Mention three specific tasks you can confidently perform using Google Sheets.
	At the end of the working day, you discover that some sales and inventory transactions have not been recorded, and a few figures do not match the supporting documents. Explain how you would handle the situation before closing.

Sales & Inventory Records Officer Job at G-Shoppers




        
    

        
        G-Shoppers provide easy food shopping support to homes, career men, and women and business people who are faced with the challenge of being constantly away from home and have less or no time to shop as well as cook.

We execute orders to supply food stuff and items such as fresh meat, sea foods, frozen, dry foods, vegetables, fruits, and prepped ready to cook food ingredients. We are based in portharcourt.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales & Inventory Records Officer

Job Location: Eliozu, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are looking for a smart, organised and detail-oriented Sales & Inventory Records Officer to accurately record daily business transactions, maintain sales and inventory records, and ensure all transactions are properly documented and completed on time.
	The ideal candidate must have good knowledge of Google Sheets and Google Docs, be comfortable working with figures and demonstrate a high level of accuracy, organisation and accountability.


What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days


	All daily sales, procurement, inventory and related transactions are accurately entered and closed out on the same day.
	Invoices and proforma invoices are prepared accurately and promptly.
	Product information, prices and inventory records are consistently updated.
	Errors, missing entries and discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly.
	Supporting documents are properly maintained and easy to retrieve.
	Management can rely on the accuracy and completeness of daily business records.


What You Will Do


	Enter daily customer sales transactions accurately into the company’s business management software.
	Prepare and generate invoices and proforma invoices as required.
	Record all procurement transactions, purchased inventory, stock movements, discounts and other relevant business transactions.
	Ensure all daily transactions are accurately entered, verified and closed out before the end of each working day.
	Maintain and update product listings, prices and other relevant information in the company’s software.
	Identify price differences and communicate with the Procurement Team for confirmation and necessary updates.
	Review daily entries, identify missing records or discrepancies and follow up to ensure corrections are made.
	Maintain accurate sales, procurement and inventory records with proper supporting documentation.
	Coordinate with the Inventory Officer, Sales and Procurement Teams to ensure records are complete and consistent.
	Prepare simple records and reports when required by management.


Requirements


	OND, HND or Bachelor’s Degree.
	Good working knowledge of Google Sheets and Google Docs.
	Ability to organise data, work with basic spreadsheet formulas and maintain accurate records.
	Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel is an advantage.
	Strong numerical ability and excellent attention to detail.
	Good organisational and time-management skills.
	Good written and verbal communication skills.
	Ability to work independently, follow instructions and meet deadlines.
	High level of honesty, integrity and accountability.
	Ability and willingness to learn new business management software. Previous experience with such software is not required.
	Relevant work experience is an advantage but not compulsory.
	Must currently reside in Port Harcourt, preferably in Eliozu or within reasonable commuting distance.


Salary
N100,000 per month (starting salary), with opportunities for salary review and growth based on performance and demonstrated competence.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Sales & Inventory Records Officer – Location in Port Harcourt" as the subject of the mail.

Application Question(s)
Answer these two questions in the body of your email:


	How would you rate your knowledge of Google Sheets and Google Docs (Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced)?
	Mention three specific tasks you can confidently perform using Google Sheets.
	At the end of the working day, you discover that some sales and inventory transactions have not been recorded, and a few figures do not match the supporting documents. Explain how you would handle the situation before closing.
